crossRefs.note: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says…
Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,

translations.web: If they say this to us, ‘Wait until we come to you!’ then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up to them.
translations.bsb: If they say, ‘Wait until we come to you,’ then we will stay where we are and will not go up to them.
translations.kjv: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.
translations.asv: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.
